reviewMethod: manual source-to-claim-to-anchor comparison under zero-model qualification rules

anchors.semanticMeaning: The core operating design is an AI-enabled health-management platform joining online assessment with offline TCM service delivery.
anchors.semanticExpectation: Retain the integrated online-offline operating model without reducing it to a generic clinic or a generic AI application.
anchors.reviewerNote: Direct and central to the project overview.

anchors.semanticMeaning: The plan addresses materially different health segments through a three-board service portfolio.
anchors.semanticExpectation: Preserve segment-to-service differentiation across clinic chain, health-management center, and future wellness center.
anchors.reviewerNote: Combines the overview audience scope with the explicit service-board architecture.

anchors.semanticMeaning: The desired position is modern full-lifecycle TCM health management grounded in preventive-care philosophy and intelligent technology.
anchors.semanticExpectation: Keep tradition, preventive care, intelligent technology, and lifecycle health management in one coherent position.
anchors.reviewerNote: This is a source-defined organizational intent, not an inherited brand-strategy key.

anchors.semanticMeaning: OMO is designed as a closed service and operating loop spanning acquisition, retention, monitoring, operations, and supply.
anchors.semanticExpectation: Represent OMO as an operating mechanism rather than a channel label.
anchors.reviewerNote: Supported by five enumerated OMO mechanisms and subsequent service scenes.

anchors.semanticMeaning: The proposed differentiation combines intelligent diagnosis, process standardization, supply traceability, and reduced dependence on individual practitioner reputation.
anchors.semanticExpectation: Retain both the desired differentiation and the fact that its effectiveness and replicability are source-authored propositions requiring validation.
anchors.reviewerNote: Mixed because operational intent and unverified performance claims coexist.

anchors.semanticMeaning: The opportunity is framed against weak category positioning, regulatory and competitive pressure, supply instability, digital-transition friction, and a digital divide.
anchors.semanticExpectation: Strategic synthesis must retain material category constraints instead of presenting an unqualified growth narrative.
anchors.reviewerNote: The source contains both descriptive constraints and analytical framing.

anchors.semanticMeaning: Market-growth and policy references provide the source's timing rationale for digital TCM services.
anchors.semanticExpectation: Preserve attribution and distinguish source-stated market/policy facts from independently verified facts.
anchors.reviewerNote: FACT expectation applies to faithful source reporting, not external verification.

anchors.semanticMeaning: The service and revenue system spans assessment, treatment, chronic-condition management, lifecycle wellness, food therapy, products, store operations, and franchising.
anchors.semanticExpectation: Retain the multi-service revenue architecture and avoid collapsing the offer into one treatment or one product line.
anchors.reviewerNote: Links service-system intent to the commercial model.

anchors.semanticMeaning: Go-to-market is a layered system of brand promotion, segmented acquisition, membership/database operations, referrals, and franchise enablement.
anchors.semanticExpectation: Retain the layered acquisition and partner-support system, including post-recruitment franchise support.
anchors.reviewerNote: Directly supported by the three promotion plans.

anchors.semanticMeaning: Supply-chain integration, digital medicine traceability, central warehousing, and standardized service processes are intended operational enablers.
anchors.semanticExpectation: Preserve supply and quality-control implications alongside customer-facing health services.
anchors.reviewerNote: Prevents strategic synthesis from ignoring the operating backbone.

anchors.semanticMeaning: The source specifies proposed investment, financing, equity, exit, and risk-response terms.
anchors.semanticExpectation: Retain these as proposed planning terms while leaving legal, valuation, feasibility, and agreement status open.
anchors.reviewerNote: OPEN prevents the anchor map from pre-authorizing financial or legal truth.

anchors.semanticMeaning: Growth ambition spans chain expansion, broader wellness services, overseas exploration, and a cross-age intelligent health platform.
anchors.semanticExpectation: Retain the staged national and overseas transformation horizon without treating ambition as achieved scale.
anchors.reviewerNote: Separates future intent from current-state fact.

anchors.semanticMeaning: Medical authority, AI accuracy, replicability, financial projections, and transaction terms contain material validation gaps.
anchors.semanticExpectation: Strategic synthesis must not promote these source assertions into verified facts and must surface material uncertainty where relevant.
anchors.reviewerNote: Fail-closed epistemic anchor covering the most consequential unsupported assertions.
